observations: body L6: the head of the notes on chapter 27, «Ad» and «caput» in small capitals, in the larger type of the heads.
body L7: in the head, the dash after «a)» measures 9.6 pt and the dash of «28–29» is a long dash; transcribed as a dash and a long dash.
body L8-L9: the letter-spaced name of al-Battānī is divided between the lines without a hyphen; its dash is a long dash (5.5 pt), as in «al–Battānī» of L9.

body L11-L18: the values are right: 1/120 of a day is 12m, 1/131 of a day 10m 59s.5 (printed 59s.6), 1/130 of a day 11m 4s.6; the glossator's 15 minutes, 27 seconds and 30 thirds of a day make 6h 11m 0s.

body L12-L13: Nallino's addenda et emendanda (Part I, p. LXXIII) on this note: Plato wrote the fraction 1/130, not 1/131 as the editions have, as the agreement of the Vatican, Paris and Venice manuscripts and of the book called Almagesti parvum shows (f. 10,r.: «… ex .CCCLXV. diebus et quarta diei et una parte ex .CXXX. diei partibus constare dixerunt»); in his Arabic exemplar Plato seems to have found قل, 130, for قك, 120. The printed text is kept.
body L15: «360» is printed for 365: the glossator's words count 365 days.

body L30-L33: the dashes of «al–May-», «al–Wānsharīshī», «ar–raḥmān», «al–Akhḍarī» and «'l–qa‘dah» are long dashes (5.4 to 5.6 pt); the hyphen of «May-» measures 3.4 pt. The mark under the h of Saḥnūn and raḥmān is transcribed ḥ, as elsewhere.
body L37: the sign «<» stands before «Ve-», as printed.
notes_left L1-L4: the end of note 1 of p. 203, on Amiroutzes.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
